I am an economist and data scientist. I use econometrics, machine learning, and network models to study behavior and to support economic decisions.

I am an Economist in Wayfair’s Pricing Algorithms team, which I joined in August 2025. From 2011 to August 2025 I was on the faculty of Johns Hopkins Carey Business School, as Assistant Professor (2011–2018) and Associate Professor of Economics (2018–August 2025). While at Johns Hopkins I also had affiliations with the [Hopkins Population Center](https://popcenter.jhu.edu), the [Institute for Data Intensive Engineering and Science](http://idies.jhu.edu), and the [Data Science and AI Institute](https://ai.jhu.edu).

## Appointments

::: {.timeline}
- **Economist III, Pricing Algorithms, Wayfair**, August 2025–present. Public title: Economist and Data Scientist.
- **Associate Professor of Economics, Johns Hopkins Carey Business School**, 2018–August 2025.
- **Assistant Professor, Johns Hopkins Carey Business School**, 2011–2018.
:::

## Education

- Ph.D. in Economics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, 2011.
- M.A. in Economics, New York University, 2005.
- B.A. in Economics, Bocconi University, 2002.
